open_points.subject: execute_function output encoding memory failure
open_points.text: and a MemoryError while it encodes or sends the outputs is a memory hit, so an output too large to send concludes resource_exhausted, never crashed.
open_points.other_text: A memory, scratch or output bound counts as hit only when the parent observes it from outside — the parent kills an environment for its wall deadline alone, and a process killed by a signal, SIGXFSZ included, exited abnormally: a MemoryError or an OSError with errno EFBIG for a file past the file-size limit escaped run and reached the parent through the exchange channel, or the output count exceeds bounds.output_bytes; code that catches such an error and returns is judged by what it returned, like any other output (owner, 2026-10-06).
open_points.question: Must a MemoryError raised by the runner after run while encoding or sending outputs count as resource_exhausted, or may memory count as hit only when a MemoryError escaped module loading or run and reached the parent?
